title: Whole Crown-pored Dry Capsule
description: One newly authored complete stylised dry crown-pored capsule on a continuous slender stem. A rounded hollow ovoid capsule narrows below a broad shallow radiating crown disc; six actual side apertures under that crown open into the real common internal cavity. Crown, perforated neck and body are one continuous closed shell with real wall thickness and a blind lower interior floor. Unlike a lotus seedhead, there are no top blind seed cups, flat perforated top plate or wide inverted-cone receptacle. Inspired only by ordinary field-poppy dry fruit morphology, not a botanical identification or cultivation item. One complete static prop, zero scenes. No exact species/biological scale, germination, harvesting, food, medicinal, chemical, growth, ecology or physical function claim; no seeds or processing.
